canonical_result.change_description: Amendment of Annexes IC, III, IIIA, IV, V, VII and VIII to Regulation (EC) No 1013/2006 regarding waste lists and packaging scope definitions.
specific_changes: Addition of entry AC300 in Part II of Annex III for plastic waste containing Annex I constituents (FEP, PFA, MFA, PVF, PVDF, PTFE, PVC).
Deletion of waste covered by entry AC300 since it is now covered by entry A3210 in List A of part 1.
Addition of 'Other (please specify)' option in block 10 of Annex VII.
canonical_result.effective_semantic: Updated scope rules for transboundary movements of waste, specifically refining the classification and exclusion criteria for plastic packaging waste under the Basel Convention framework.
